comment_text: The Scout 400 LXF represents a notable step in center-console design—pairing a carbon epoxy hull with twin Mercury V12s and Seakeeper 3 brings a rare combination of performance and offshore stability in a 40-foot package. Features like the Garmin Glass Helm, hydraulic beach platform, and articulating rod launchers point to a hybrid fishing-and-lifestyle audience.
